paragraphs: Lucy Zodion is a British electrical manufacturer of lighting control, power distribution and electrical safety equipment for highways and street lighting infrastructure. The product range covers power management and control equipment for street lighting. Hardware includes photocells offered in NEMA and conduit options. Other hardware covers steel and cast iron pillars, in-ground units and power distribution enclosures.

Alongside the hardware, Ki. is presented as an ecosystem of smart city hardware and software backed by a UK based service team. Ki. nodes connect with other assets in that ecosystem over LoRaWAN or Narrow-Band IoT.

The pages name Luminaire Manufacturers as one group offered street lighting control gear. One case study describes feeder pillars supplied for a Nottinghamshire County Council street-lighting project. The photocell range is grouped by solution, one of which is Public Sector & Local Authorities.

quote.text: Our product range spans power management and control equipment for street lighting
